positive_terms: Description of effects considered, related impacts and time horizons in which they are likely to materialise (pollution)
污染财务影响的对象与时间范围
Description of effects considered, related impacts and time horizons in which they are likely to materialise (pollution)。污染财务影响的对象与时间范围。按污染风险或事故、财务项目、币种、期间及预期时间区分。收入占比不是污染量，准备金不是已发生修复支出。
